name: Morning brief
description: Today's weather and the newest world, AI and robotics headlines, numbered. Use it when the user asks for the morning brief, the news, the headlines or today's weather; pick a section when they ask for only one. The user can then open a headline by its number. When reporting it, read the weather and every headline, briefly and grouped by section, with their numbers: this is the one time a longer reply is wanted.

section.description: all unless the user asks for only the weather or only one kind of news.
